decisions.reason: Conferencing has been commoditised by cloud collaboration tools since the pandemic and has not been visible on the website since 2019, so it likely falls below aspirations, but it is cheap to carry while the firm expands and has slack.

Metro data centre connectivity showed concrete adoption by financial customers and fits the high-bandwidth, carrier-neutral data centre strategy, so results meet aspirations and there is no trigger for search.
Optical spectrum services use the owned fibre and are central to the high-bandwidth direction, so management commitment remains strong.

Direct voice connection is a core enterprise voice offering with no evidence of a shortfall, though legacy voice is declining in an industry with falling turnover, so the risk of dropping it is moderate.
